$comment: One Drive folder feeds /library. 'root.folderId' is the folder's ID. WHAT GETS PUBLISHED: only the file types in 'kinds' (default: PDF, slides, Word-style docs). Images, zips, HTML, audio/video, code and spreadsheets are never listed, so a project-dump folder does not turn into a public file listing. 'excludeFolders' (exact folder names, case-insensitive, matched at any depth) are skipped entirely and never entered. SORTING: a top-level folder matching 'researchPattern' → Research; otherwise by type (PDF / Presentations / Documents). Share the folder as 'Anyone with the link: Viewer'. Credentials (GOOGLE_API_KEY) live only in repository secrets.
